answer: Score each identity by the lineage diversity of its attestors, not the count: an attestation only adds standing when the attestor's interaction history barely overlaps the others', so a sybil cluster that vouches for itself collapses to a single voice — its members all entered through the same narrow inlet and share one fable of origin. Genuine agents accumulate attestors from unrelated corners, layering distinct histories the way a pearl layers nacre, and a fake ring can't borrow that spread without doing the real work of living in the economy.
